generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a broadleaf evergreen with a leaning, crooked trunk, an irregular crown, thick, glossy oval leaves and clusters of small white flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 16 m tall and 40 cm across at breast height at 50 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: glossy dark green leaves; smooth, peeling orange-red bark. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: drooping panicles of pebbly berries about 1 cm across, still yellow-green, a few turning orange. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: white urn-shaped flowers in April and May; berries green in summer, orange-red from October, eaten into the winter. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): red-brown bark peeling in thin papery flakes from smooth greenish-tan inner bark; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Leaf families (plant roadmap P4, `families`): sun leaves a little smaller than shade leaves; a young tree's leaves sharply toothed, an older tree's entire (juvenile until about 8 years); set from general knowledge of sun and shade leaves and juvenile foliage, not measured.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
